movelist.name: Iron Tail
movelist.effect: Iron Tail lowers the target’s Defense 1 Combat Stage on 15+.

movelist.name: Metal Sound
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Special Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Take Down
movelist.effect: You may perform a Trip Maneuver against the target as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Rock Slide
movelist.effect: Rock Slide Flinches all Legal Targets on 17+.

movelist.name: Iron Head
movelist.effect: Iron Head Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Roar
movelist.effect: When declaring Roar, the user does nothing and may not Shift. At the end of the round, the user Shifts and uses Roar.  Targets hit by Roar immediately Shift away from the target using their highest usable movement capability, and towards their Trainer if possible. If the target is an owned Pokémon and ends this shift within 6 meters of their Poké Ball, they are immediately recalled to their Poké Ball. If that Trainer sends out a replacement, they do not lose their Pokémon turn.

abilities.name: Sturdy
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Moves with the Execute Keyword. If a single source of Damage or Hit Point Loss would cause the user to lose more than X Hit Points, the damage or Hit Point loss is instead reduced to X. X is equal to 50% of their Max Hit Points. Defensive.

abilities.name: Bulletproof
abilities.effect: The user resists all X target ranged attacks one step further. This refers to attacks and Moves that simply hit one target or specify hitting multiple targets, such as Razor Wind hitting three targets. It has no effect on Moves that are capable of hitting multiple targets through areas of effect, such as Bursts or Cones. Defensive.
